title: Italian Pizza
body:
** REPLACES BREAD WITH ITALIAN PIZZA MODEL**

![yum](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5d9a3ae4e4724c52dc3de8dcd3ccb9aed27d2cc7_0.webp)

**this resource pack remakes the bread texture as Italian pizza model. the purpose of this is mostly decoration. but it can also be used as actual bread with cool animations**
